newsitem.title: SPAIN: At least eight dead in Spain traffic crash.
newsitem.headline: At least eight dead in Spain traffic crash.

text.p: A minibus carrying Japanese tourists collided with a truck on Tuesday close to the cathedral town of Toledo, killing at least eight people, state television reported.
The minibus burst into flames shortly after the crash.
Local agency Europa Press later said the death toll had risen to nine, but local officials could not confirm this.
Eight of the victims were in the minibus while the other was a passenger in the truck, local media reported.
Ambulances rushed two people with burns to a Madrid hospital some 50 km (30 miles) away after the crash on a motorway outside Toledo, according to news reports.
